bibliographic.title: Clockwork Heart
bibliographic.author: Alex C. Hughes
bibliographic.description:
A boy shows up on your door saying that you must steal something for the Vampire King or he'll kill your brother.

Clockwork Heart is a steampunk adventure in the style of the old Choose Your Own Adventure books. It's fun, compelling, with enough character that you'll really care about what happens next.

The author is Alex C. Hughes, http://www.ahugheswriter.com, author of the Mindspace Investigations book series.
